text_block_list.text: —The scent of night, flashing neon lights, a chaotic roar of voices. The dark of night hides countless thrills and dangers... and I had completely forgotten that.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Come now, don't be like that! Just hear me out, will ya?!
I've got a seriously juicy deal just for you... Sounds enticing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Young Man
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it'll only take a sec! Come on, right this way!
choice_data_list: (I can't... I just can't say no...)

text_block_list.text:
It's always like this. I despise my timid personality...
At times like this, my only option is to give in and ride it out. That's all I—

—...
One sneaky fox, one helpless puppy, huh?
(WHAM...!)

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Young Man
text_block_list.text: Eep...?! Wh-What was that sound...?!

Feasting on frightened little critters makes you feel big, does it?
...Pathetic excuse for a beast.

Before I realized it, an Umamusume was standing right beside us.
Apparently, she had just kicked the wall to intimidate the young man...
That goes for you too.

Even a pup's got fangs.
Don't let 'em go to waste just for show.

I broke the chain. Now bicker and bite, or tuck your tail and run—
The rest is yours to "choose."

Snapping back to my senses, I somehow managed to scramble away—
Yet for some reason, her command to "choose" kept echoing in my mind...
A few days later, the Debut Selection Races were held—an event where pre-debut Umamusume showcase their abilities in hopes of being scouted by a trainer.
Determined to scout a trainee of my own, I eagerly headed out to observe, but—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, over here! Put that one right there, and the other in the corner!
Man, you're a lifesaver, helping us set up!
...I couldn't say no again. This was a golden opportunity, and I really wanted to watch the races... but it's my own fault for not speaking up.
choice_data_list: (...If only I could be more like that girl from the alley.)

text_block_list.text:
I recall the supremely confident expression of the girl who helped me back then.
Yes, with sharp eyes just like—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! She's finally making her entrance...!
The Symboli family's very own—Sirius Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's already racked up stellar results in mock races.
I can't wait to see what kind of run she puts on today.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All runners are loaded in the gates!
Today's Selection Race—is underway!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...!
Early morning rain left the track yielding, but—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't slow her down one bit...!
Just as the rumors said, what unbelievable power!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh—!! HAAA—!!
Digging into the turf with monstrous strength, she tears freely across the track, completely trampling her rivals in her wake.
With every heavy clod of turf kicked skyward, her fighting spirit blazes hotter and hotter—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!
Letting out a roar like a famished wolf, she claims victory.

A ferocious intensity that captivates all onlookers, as if screaming "This is where I reign!"...
I had never seen—running like this before.

I can't calm my pounding heart. I want to see more of her running...
Driven by that urge, I almost dashed forward to call out to her—when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: That was a magnificent race...!! With talent like yours, the Classic Triple Crown is well within reach!! I swear I'll drill every ounce of my experience into you!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: Me too...!! Please, won't you aim for the Triple Crown with me?! I may be a rookie, but I'll provide the absolute best environment, data, and strategy!
choice_data_list: (Ugh, there's no way I can squeeze in...!)

text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by the raw passion of the other trainers, I couldn't get a word in.
Even so, I lingered nearby, desperately waiting for an opening, but...

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you just standing around for?!
Give us a hand over here!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, folks, but I've already picked mine.
—Hey. You.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You, the pup over there!
I'm talking to you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Starting today, you're my Trainer.
Any objections?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I asked if you had any objections.

Why did she choose me when I couldn't even speak up...?
I don't know the answer. Even so—
I recall her commanding, majestic running form. Getting to train a horsegirl of her caliber is the greatest honor any Trainer could ever ask for.
choice_data_list: (Alright, I'll give it everything I've got starting tomorrow!)

text_block_list.text:
However—that fiery motivation was snuffed out almost immediately.
The next day, I eagerly brought the training regimen I had prepared, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—That covers the future course of action.
We'll stick to this current plan until my debut.

The training plan she presented was utterly flawless, leaving no room for critique...
Above all, her commanding tone carried a heavy pressure that brooked no argument.
choice_data_list: ...Um, for what it's worth, I also—
...Um, for what it's worth, I also—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
If you don't have any complaints... keep your mouth shut and watch, "Trainer"?

Sirius Symboli... A haughty horsegirl overflowing with supreme confidence.
Caught under her fierce, overwhelming gaze, the words died in my throat—
